name: iq
description: Quiescent supply current of bandgap_top at every PVT corner, against README.md's ratified Iq < 50 uA row (binds at ff/125C/3.63V).
claim: README.md 'Target specification (RATIFIED 2026-07-31)' -> row 'Quiescent current': < 50 uA, corner binding 'binds at FF / 125 C / 3.63 V (leakage + fastest devices)'. Total supply current drawn by bandgap_top at its quiescent operating point, measured at every point of the full PVT grid; the reported figure is the worst (largest) corner.

iq_ua.description: RATIFIED spec: quiescent current < 50 uA (README.md target-spec table). The min=1uA floor is not a spec line: it fails any corner that collapsed into the degenerate near-zero-current state (design/bandgap_operating_point.md 4.2) instead of recording the collapse as an excellent Iq.

vref.description: Not a spec check -- the accuracy claim lives in sim/output-voltage-tc/. This wide sanity window only asserts the loop was in its intended operating state when Iq was measured; a corner outside it makes the Iq number uninterpretable.
